result.summary: The page layout is intact, but the promotional banner has a critical visual failure: its white text on a pale background is nearly unreadable.

issues.description: Promotional banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout' is white on a very pale mint background and is almost invisible / washed out due to insufficient color contrast
issues.suggestion: Change banner text to a dark color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements so the offer is clearly readable
